items.informal_name: Eventually, $1 - \frac{1}{\ln n}$ Exceeds Any Constant Less Than 1
items.type: ∀ c < 1, ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, c < 1 - AkraBazziRecurrence.smoothingFn ↑n
items.informal_description: For any real number $c < 1$, there exists a threshold $N \in \mathbb{N}$ such that for all $n \geq N$, the inequality $c < 1 - \frac{1}{\ln n}$ holds. This describes the asymptotic behavior of the smoothing function $\varepsilon(n) = \frac{1}{\ln n}$ in the Akra-Bazzi method for recurrence relations.

items.type: ∀ (n : ℕ) {m : ℝ}, 2 ≤ m → (1 - 1 / m)⁻¹ * (1 / m ^ (n + 1).factorial) ≤ 1 / (m ^ n.factorial) ^ n
items.informal_description: For any natural number $n$ and any real number $m$ such that $m \ge 2$, the following inequality holds: $$ \left(1 - \frac{1}{m}\right)^{-1} \cdot \frac{1}{m^{(n+1)!}} \le \frac{1}{(m^{n!})^n} $$

items.informal_name: Smoothing Function Eventually Greater Than Constants Less Than One
items.type: ∀ c < 1, ∀ᶠ (x : ℝ) in Filter.atTop, c < 1 - AkraBazziRecurrence.smoothingFn x
items.informal_description: For any real constant $c < 1$, there exists some $N$ such that for all $x > N$, the inequality $c < 1 - \frac{1}{\ln x}$ holds. This describes the asymptotic behavior of the smoothing function $\varepsilon(x) = \frac{1}{\ln x}$ in the Akra-Bazzi method.
For all sufficiently large $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the expression $1 - \frac{1}{\ln n}$ is positive, i.e., $1 - \frac{1}{\ln n} > 0$.

items.informal_name: Roth Number is Little-o of Identity Function at Infinity
items.informal_description: The Roth number function on natural numbers is asymptotically negligible compared to the identity function, meaning that for every $\varepsilon > 0$, there exists an $N$ such that for all $n \geq N$, the Roth number of $n$ is less than $\varepsilon \cdot n$.

items.informal_name: Akra-Bazzi Recurrence Inequality for Critical Exponent and Smoothing Function
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] {T : ℕ → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : α → ℝ} {r : α → ℕ → ℕ} [inst_1 : Nonempty α]
  (R : AkraBazziRecurrence T g a b r),
  ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
    ∀ (i : α),
      ↑(r i n) ^ AkraBazziRecurrence.p a b * (1 - AkraBazziRecurrence.smoothingFn ↑(r i n)) ≤
        b i ^ AkraBazziRecurrence.p a b * ↑n ^ AkraBazziRecurrence.p a b * (1 - AkraBazziRecurrence.smoothingFn ↑n)
items.informal_description: For all sufficiently large natural numbers $ n $ and for all $ i $ in the finite type $ \alpha $, the inequality $ (r(i,n))^p \cdot (1 - \varepsilon(r(i,n))) \leq (b(i))^p \cdot n^p \cdot (1 - \varepsilon(n)) $ holds, where $ p $ is the critical exponent satisfying $ \sum_{i \in \alpha} a_i (b_i)^p = 1 $, $ r(i,n) $ defines the recurrence's index mapping, and $ \varepsilon $ represents a small positive function related to the smoothing term $ 1/\ln(n) $.

items.informal_name: Eventual Upper Bound for $ r_i(n) $ in Akra-Bazzi Recurrence
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] {T : ℕ → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : α → ℝ} {r : α → ℕ → ℕ} [inst_1 : Nonempty α]
  (R : AkraBazziRecurrence T g a b r), ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ (i : α), ↑(r i n) ≤ b i * ↑n + ↑n / Real.log ↑n ^ 2
items.informal_description: For all indices $ i $ and sufficiently large natural numbers $ n $, the coefficient function $ r_i(n) $ satisfies the inequality $ r_i(n) \leq b_i n + \frac{n}{(\log n)^2} $, where $ b_i $ is a parameter of the Akra-Bazzi recurrence and $ \log $ denotes the natural logarithm.

items.informal_name: Eventual Inequality for Akra-Bazzi Recurrence Coefficients
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] {T : ℕ → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : α → ℝ} {r : α → ℕ → ℕ} [inst_1 : Nonempty α]
  (R : AkraBazziRecurrence T g a b r), ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ (i : α), b i * ↑n - ↑n / Real.log ↑n ^ 2 ≤ ↑(r i n)
items.informal_description: For all sufficiently large natural numbers $ n $ and for each index $ i $, the inequality $ b_i n - \frac{n}{(\log n)^2} \leq r_i(n) $ holds, where $ b_i $ and $ r_i(n) $ are parameters of the Akra-Bazzi recurrence.
